name: Holiday Peeled Apple Pie or French Silk / Banana Cream Pie
whyItWorks: Peeled baked apples in a flaky white flour crust (or smooth chocolate French Silk / Banana Cream pie) offer seedless, nut-free holiday dessert options.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Confirm no lemon juice or walnuts were added to the apple pie, and take a Lactaid if topping with vanilla ice cream or eating cream pie.
watchOuts: Ensure apples are fully peeled and no walnuts/pecans are in the streusel
